user.title: Connect to the eufy bridge
user.description: Enter the TLS gateway hostname, HTTPS port and bridge access token. Live video is disabled until a secure media gateway is available.

hassio_confirm.title: Set up discovered eufy bridge
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered the eufy-sdk bridge add-on at {host}. Camera streams will use RTSP at {rtsp}.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the eufy bridge
reconfigure.description: Update the TLS gateway hostname or port. Leave the replacement token blank to retain the existing token.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.description: A verification code was sent to your eufy account. Enter it below (tick Resend to request a new one).

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description:
Enter the characters from the image below (tick Refresh for a new one).

{image}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate the eufy bridge
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge at {host} needs to log in again (its session expired, so eufy is asking for 2FA/captcha). Make sure the bridge is running and reachable, then submit to continue.

reauth_token.title: Update bridge access token
reauth_token.description: The bridge rejected or is missing its access credential. Enter the new 64-character token. This is separate from your Eufy account login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge at that host/port.
error.invalid_2fa: That verification code was not accepted.
error.invalid_bridge_token: The bridge access token is missing, invalid or rejected.

abort.invalid_discovery_info: The eufy bridge add-on sent incomplete discovery information.
abort.manual_secure_setup_required: Secure bridge setup must be completed manually with a verified TLS endpoint and access token.

init.title: eufy bridge options
init.description: Adjust how often the bridge polls the eufy cloud for device state.

data_description.soc_refresh_seconds: How often HA re-reads a Solarbank's discharge/charge limits from the cloud, so an app-side change reflects on the sliders. Only applies if you have a Solarbank.

preset_empty.message: Preset {slot} has no stored position. Save one there from the eufy app first.

confirm.title: Turn off stream preloading for {camera}
confirm.description:
{camera} runs on battery, and "Preload camera stream" is on for it. Home Assistant then keeps its stream running permanently and reconnects whenever it ends, which wakes the camera over and over and drains its battery.

Submit to turn preloading off for this camera. Live view still works; it just starts when you open it.
